verdict.rationale: Duplicate-identity detection is a fair question for a customer onboarding and risk-screening platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence covers only sanctions, PEP and adverse-media screening, case management and transaction monitoring. Nothing shows the product comparing faces or documents across verifications or flagging the same identity resurfacing under different names. External-identifier customer lookup is an adjacent record-retrieval feature, not duplicate-identity detection.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, the platform detects repeat and duplicate identities across verifications — the same face or document resurfacing under different names is flagged automatically
